summary_en: The video showcases Vietnamese regional landscapes and local life, featuring a culinary journey to explore the specialty fish rice noodle soup, bun ken, in Ha Tien. It highlights the ingredient preparation, broth cooking, dish tasting, seafood harvesting activities, and sunset scenery at Mui Nai.
